output_json.summary: The patch fixes the CWE-022 backslash path traversal in vertx-web StaticHandlerImpl by inserting `.replace('\\', '/')` on the decoded request path before HttpUtils.removeDots, so backslash traversal payloads (e.g. %5c..%5c) are collapsed as path separators. This is the exact upstream vertx-web 3.9.4 fix. I independently reran the POV (now 404/exit 1, blocked) and the regression suite (64/64 StaticHandlerTest pass). Accepted.
